decision: Rejected: startup neutral, mixed native RAM results, no recovery of largest interpreter TLB-pressure regression. Restore ca842f3 CPU implementation.

windows.scope: Five alternating headless rtts Win95 startup prefixes, stop at 300M instructions, host network disconnected, no frame capture or UI control. Guest/device fields and total instruction count match; implementation JIT counters, disk path and host timing may differ; not bytewise RAM equality or Explorer readiness/timing.

interpreter.scope: Three alternating headless CPU-only RAM sweep pairs, stackless translation baseline versus shared lookup context on slow paths. Same program, result, instruction counts. One host, no confidence intervals.

baseline.scope:
Original dependent-load sweep, not an lmbench port or official lmbench score.

Same guest COM for a CPU/JIT-only PCEMU harness and QEMU's full PC TCG.
Supervisor flat/identity-paged 4KiB RAM, no measured disk activity. QEMU uses
host socket-receipt timing; PCEMU timestamps in its port handler. Reported
ns/load includes guest execution, guards and dispatch, not raw host DRAM latency.
